create_rmsprop_tf_optimizer: create an RMSpropTFOptimizer instance with custom learning rate, momentum, and alpha parameters
run_rmsprop_tf_step: run a single optimization step using the RMSpropTFOptimizer step method with an optional closure
build_rmsprop_tf_from_config: build an RMSPropTF optimizer instance from a dictionary config with lr, momentum, and eps
prepare_rmsprop_tf_param_groups: prepare an RMSpropTFOptimizer by passing param groups to the RMSPropTF prepare method
review_rmsprop_tf_centered: review the RMSpropTFOptimizer centered mode which normalizes gradients by variance estimation
